wholePhysicalScope: Exact 14-point OSM building way 525964000. Campus directory places the museum in the Cibali factory C Block and the operator locates its main door opposite the Cibali T5 stop on the Golden Horn side.
lodDetails: All levels retain the exact Cibali factory wing, its roof profile, the arched industrial window rhythm and the street-side museum entrance. Near levels resolve recessed arched windows, brick and lintel relief, roof trims and approach stairs.
limitations: This is the street-visible C Block host wing of the former Cibali Tobacco Factory. The separate university wings and the enclosed subsurface cistern remain beyond its exterior scope.

The unnamed footprint is attributed to C Block by the university building directory, museum’s tram-side entrance description and the Qualla location inside the native polygon. The OSM museum point farther northwest serves as an identity reference. The exact doorway position is estimated.

The restored masonry and arched industrial openings follow the university’s account. Storey heights and counts, the exact bay rhythm, roof hips, connector glazing, lintels and color differences are reconstructions.
The unchanged Terrarium field sets the street-side approach and local slope. The stair, masonry base and side contacts are approximate.
